property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address, the reference contract's transfer(...) call never returns true when any low-level call to the callee fails (it will revert), whereas the mutant can complete and return true even if a callee call fails; the test fuzzes inputs and uses a helper that makes the callee revert to expose this difference.

For any input where _tos is non-empty and the callee address implements a function transferFrom that returns (i.e. the low-level call succeeds), the reference C.transfer always completes successfully (does not revert) and returns true; the mutant inverts the inner require and will revert whenever the callee call succeeds, so there exist inputs (a non-empty _tos and a callee that accepts the call) that make the mutant revert while the reference succeeds.

For any non-empty _tos array, the reference contract never returns false from transfer when any callee call fails (it instead reverts), whereas the mutant may return false (not revert) if an inner low-level call fails; i.e. reference either returns true or reverts, mutant can return false for some inputs where a callee fails.
